title: WDV: A Broad Data Verbalisation Dataset Built from Wikidata

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the distribution of unique predicates, entity types, and topics in existing Knowledge Graph datasets (e.g., noting that the top 7.7% of unique predicates represent 90% of unique triples in T-REx), and applying stratified sampling to ensure balanced representation across a wide variety of themes rather than over-representing common domains like biographies and geography.
